title: Concept: Link to an IDE workspace directory
description: A link into a .idea or .vscode project directory in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: IDE state names the project modules, local paths and sometimes data-source passwords, and serving it tells an attacker how the repository is laid out.
applicability: Static exports, documentation sites and repository browsers.
risk: Project layout and saved data-source credentials shorten the path to the database.
